verdict.rationale: A government tax and customs portal could plausibly offer user-defined automation, such as rules that trigger payments or actions on deadlines or notices, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only subscribing to electronic notifications and managing communication channels ([at-financas-docs-1], [at-financas-docs-2]). Those are adjacent notification controls, not user-defined event-triggered rules. No documentation of a rule engine, triggers or automated actions appears anywhere in the pack.
